title: U.S. auto market predictions for 2030: More hybrids, no Chinese entrants
summary_full: Despite growing speculation that it won't be long until Chinese autos are sold in the U.S., John Murphy doesn't expect that to happen by 2030.
summary_public: Despite growing speculation that it won't be long until Chinese autos are sold in the U.S., John Murphy doesn't expect that to happen by 2030.
